purpose: Describe a manner or paraphrase a way of understanding something.
keywords: Quoted content + というふうに
I set a small target, something like “one line a day.”
We proceed by washing first and then cutting.
If you think of this as practice, you can relax.
formation: Quoted content + というふうに
restrictions: Can present wording, procedure, or an interpretation as one way of doing it.
mistake: It does not necessarily claim an exact verbatim quotation.
